claim: The incident occurred at approximately 2:15 PM on September 14, 2026, in Aisle 4.
Forklift unit FL-118, operated by Dana Whitfield, struck shelving unit 4-B while turning too quickly to exit the aisle.
Dana sustained a minor injury to the left hand.
The operator's forklift certification had lapsed the previous month.
Dana Whitfield was wearing a helmet and steel-toe boots as required by safety policy at the time of the incident.
Dana Whitfield is a Warehouse Associate II in the Logistics Department.
Marcus Ilunga is a second-shift Warehouse Associate.
Marcus states the incident happened closer to 3:00 PM, after shift change.
Marcus states the Aisle 4 guard rail had been loose for weeks.
Marcus states the alarm did not sound.
The guard rail was repaired and confirmed secure at 9:00 AM on the day of the incident.
Records show Dana Whitfield's certification was renewed March 2026 and is current.
Danvers states the alarm sounded immediately and the aisle was cleared within a minute.
Okafor states the alarm did not sound and someone had to get Priya in person.
